newsitem.title: USA: Evans Environmental to build plant.
newsitem.headline: Evans Environmental to build plant.

text.p: Evans Environmental Corp said Tuesday that a subsidiary agreed to enter a joint venture with a private Florida company to build a plant for producing briquettes used as blast furnace feedstocks.

The subsidiary, American Remedial Technologies Inc, will operate the plant, to be built in West Virginia. The facility is expected to generate about $23 million in revenue in its first full year of operation.
The plant, due to be operational in early 1997, will produce briquettes with high iron content from recycled material.
Evans did not identify its partner in a statement announcing the venture. Company officials could not be immediately reached for comment.
